description.value: Fan Tan Café has been serving homemade Chinese food for over 35 years in the heart of Victoria's historic Chinatown, earning Best Chinese Food in Victoria honours in both 2022 and 2023. It is a fully licensed dine-in restaurant with a complete bar and daily drink specials, alongside an extensive menu featuring signature Wor Won Ton soups, bubble tea, and a dedicated gluten-free menu. Dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery are all available.
